results.title: Ƴan sandan Turkiya sun kai samame tashar yaɗa labaran Sozcu TV mai zaman kanta
results.content: Gwamnatin Turkiya ta dakatar da shugabanin gidan talabijin mai zaman kansa Sozcu TV tare da naɗa mutumin da zai jagoranci tashar na wucin gadi.

results.title: Kurdawa na samun nasara a kan mayakan ISIS a Syria
results.content: Dubban yan gudun hijira na ci gaba da tserewa fadan da ake tabkawa tsakanin Kurdawa da mayakan Jihadin kungiyar Isis a kasar Syriya al'amarin da ya haifar da kwararar 'yan gudun hijira a kasar Turkiya.

results.title: An samu raguwar kona motoci a bikin sabuwar shekara a Faransa
results.content: Gwamnatin Faransa tace an samu raguwar yawan adadin motocin da ake konewa a lokacin bikin sabuwar shekara da kashi 12 cikin 100 a cikin kasar. alkalumma sun nuna cewa a jajibirin sabuwar shekara an kone motoci 940 sabanin 1,067, da aka cinna wa wuta a shekarar da ta gabata.

results.title: Dakarun Faransa sun shiga Ukraine a ɓoye a matsayin masu foraswa - Bincike
results.content: Wani bincike da gidan rediyon Faransa na RFI ya gudanar ya bankaɗo yadda gwamnatin Faransa ta tura wasu jami’an sojojinta zuwa Ukraine a ɓoye, domin horas da dakarun ƙasar tare da taimaka musu wajen kula da makaman yaƙin da Faransa ta samar musu.

results.title: Kotun Duniya ta bukaci Afirka ta Kudu ta cafke El-Bashir
results.content: Kotun hukunta manyan laifufuka a duniya ICC ko kuma CPI ta bukaci hukumomin kasar Afirka ta kudu da su kama shugaban Sudan Umar Hasan El-bashir wanda ke halarar taron shugabannin Afirka yanzu haka a birnin Johannesburg.

results.title: An cafke mutane da dama kan zargin juyin mulki a Gambia
results.content: An cafke mutane da dama, da ake zargi suna da hannu a yunkurin jurin juyin mulkin da aka yi a kasar Gambia, lokacin da shugaban kasa Yahya Jammeh ke ziyara a birnin Dubai, wanda kuma ya dora alhakin harin kan ‘yan kasashen waje da bai bayyana sunayen su ba.

results.title: Hukumar zaɓen Gambia ta sahale wa Shugaba Barrow tsayawa takara a wa'adi na uku
results.content: Hukumar zaɓe a Gambia ta bai wa shugaba Adama Barrow damar sake tsayawa takarar neman kujerar shugabancin ƙasar a wa’adi na uku a zaɓen da a a gudanar a wata mai zuwa.

results.title: Ambaliyar Ruwan sama ta yi sanadiyar mutuwar mutane 12 a Jojiya
results.content: yanzu haka dai masu kula da namun daji na ci gaba da farautar namun daji a tsakkiyar birnin Tbilissi na kasar Jojiya, bayan da ambaliyar Ruwan sama da aka sheka a birnin ta rusa gidan namun dajin da a halin yanzu suka fantsama a cikin gari

results.title: Ana ci gaba da aikin neman tarkacen jirgin AirAsia
results.content: Yau Juma’a masu aiki neman sassan jirgin saman da ya yi hadari a kan tekun Java na kasar Indonesia, sun ci gaba da aikin, kuma suna gab da kaiwa inda lamarin ya faru. An dakatar da aikin neman Jirgin ne saboda matsalar Yanayi a tekun Indonesia

results.title: Shin me ke sanya mutane kai wa shugabanni hari
results.content: A farkon makon nan ne shugaban Najeriya Bola Ahmad Tinubu ya bayar da umarnin sakin wasu matasa sama da 70 da aka kama bayan da suka yi masa ihu da kuma jifa a masallacin juma’a ranar 13 ga watan da muke ciki, matakin da ya sa mutane ke yabawa shugaban da kwatanta shi a matsayin jagora mai tausayi da son talakawa.

results.title: Taron Kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25
results.content: A yau lahadi ake buda taron shugabannin kasashen kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25 a birnin Jonnesburg na kasar Afirka ta Kudu, taron da zai mayar da hankali kan batutuwa da dama da suka shafi kasashen nahiyar.

results.title: Jami’an Italiya sun yi kokarin ceto jirgin ruwan Bakin haure
results.content: Jami’an kula da jiragen ruwa a kasar Italiya sun nasarar ceto wani jirgin ruwa da ya samu matsala a tsakiyar teku shake da bakin haure kimanin 450 bayan sun yi nasarar ceto rayuwan bakin haure da dama a cikin kwanaki biyu da suka gabata.

results.title: Najeriya, Nijar, Kamaru da Chadi sun cimma yarjejeniyar yaƙi da ta'addanci
results.content: Najeriya ta sanar da wani shirin tsaro tsakaninta da Kamaru, Chadi da Nijar wanda zai bai wa sojoji damar bin ƴanbindiga har zuwa kilomita 5 a cikin iyakokin kasashen juna.

results.title: Kotu ba ta amince da tsige shugaba Rajoanarimampianina ba
results.content: Kotun kolin kasar Madagascar ta yi watsi da matakin tsige shugaban kasar Hery Rajoana-rimampianina da majalisar dokokin kasar ta yi a ranar 26 ga watan jiya.

results.title: An sake zabar Netanyahu a matsayin shugaban Jam’iyya mai mulki
results.content: An sake zabar Fraiministan kasar Isra’ila Benjamin Netanyahu, a matsayin shugaban jam’iyyar Likud mai mulkin kasar, a wani zaben fitar da gwanin da aka yi jiya Alhamis. Zaben na zuwa ne a daidai lokacin da ake shirin yin wani zaben gaggawa a kasar, inda ya kayar da abokin takarar shi Danny Danon mai ra’ayin gurguzu.

results.title: Iraqi na shirin kwancewa mayaƙan da ke goyawa Iran baya a cikin ƙasar ɗamara ta ƙarfi
results.content: Gwamnatin Iran ta umarci sojojin ƙasar da su kutsa yankunan da ƙungiyoyin ƴan bindiga da ke marawa Iran baya ke da sansani don kwance musu ɗammara ta ƙarfin tsiya.

results.title: Sarkozy ya soki kawance da ke fada da mayakan IS
results.content: Tsohon shugaban Faransa Nicolas Sarkozy ya yi kakkausar ga kawancen dakarun kasashen duniya a karkashin jagorancin Amurka, dangane da yadda ya kasa murkushe mayakan da ke da’awar jihadi a kasashen Syria da Iraki.

results.title: Malaman jami'a a Mali sun shiga mako na huɗu da faro yajin aiki
results.content: Malaman jami’oi a Mali sun shiga mako na huɗu da faro yajin aikin da suke gudanarwa.

results.title: Hillary na gudanar da yakin neman zaben shugabancin Amurka
results.content: Tsohuwar sakatariyar harkokin wajen Amurka Hillary Clinton ta kaddamar da yakin neman zabenta na neman tsayawa takarar shugabancin Amurka a jiya asabar, inda ta ce tana fatar kasancewar mace ta farko da za ta jagoranci kasar a tarihi.

results.title: Ƙasashen Turai biyar sun cimma yarjejeniyar fara jibge baƙin haure a Rwanda
results.content: Wasu ƙasashen Tarayyar Turai biyar sun amince da wani tsari da zai bayar da damar samar da wani sansanin jibge baƙin haure a ƙasar Rwanda, da zai shafi mutanen da ke samun mafaka a ƙasashensu ba tare da cikakkun takardun izini ba, matakin da ya jima yana fuskantar chachaka, musamman daga ƴan kare hakkin Ɗan Adam.

results.title: RFI Hausa zai sauya Shafinsa na Intanet
results.content: Daga 15 ga watan Yuni, hausa.rfi.fr, shafin Intanet na RFI Hausa zai sauya sabuwar fuska, mai bayar da muhimmanci kan salon yada labarai irin na rediyo da hotunan bidiyo.

results.title: An sake zaɓen Gilbert Houngbo a matsayin shugaban hukumar ILO ta MDD
results.content: An sake zaɓen tsohon Firaministan Togo, Gilbert Houngbo a matsayin shugaban hukumar ƙwadago ta duniya yayin zaman da Majalisar ɗinkin duniya ta gudanar jiya litinin a birnin Geneva, kodayake sai a ranar 1 ga watan Oktoban baɗi ne zai faro sabon wa’adin a hukumance.

results.title: Hatsarin babbar mota a Burundi ya kashe matasan jam'iyya mai mulkin ƙasar 31
results.content: Akalla mambobin ƙungiyar matasan jam’iyyar CNDD-FDD mai mulki a ƙasar Burundi, waɗanda aka fi sani da Imbonerakure, su 31 ne suka rasa rayukansu a wani mummunan hatsarin mota da ya auku a daren Lahadi a arewacin ƙasar.

results.title: Najeriya ta nemi sulhu kan rikicin kakakin Ramaphosa da jakadanta a Afrika ta Kudu
results.content: Ofishin jakadancin Najeriya a Afirka ta Kudu ya yi kira da a kai zuciya nesa tare da sulhu bayan kalaman da mai magana da yawun Shugaba Cyril Ramaphosa, Vincent Magwenya, ya yi game da Babban Jakadan Najeriya a ƙasar, Femi Fani-Kayode.

results.title: Nijar: Wa'adin biyan kashi 600 na hayar shagunan kasuwa ya kare 17 ga Nuwamba
results.content: A yau ne wa’adin da kamfanin SOCOGEM wanda ke da alhakin tafiyar da babbar kasuwar birnin Yamai na Jamhuriyar Nijar ya bai wa ƴan kasuwar na su biya kuɗin hayar shago ƙarƙashin sabon farashin da ya ƙaru da kaso 600% ko kuma su fice daga kasuwar ke cika.Wannan matakin dai ya shafi shaguna sama da dubu 4 a cikin da wajen kasuwar.Ibrahim Garba, guda daga cikin wakilan ƴan kasuwar ya ce sun zura ido don ganin irin matakin da gwamnati za ta ɗauka domin warware rikicin. Ga dai abin da ya ke cewa:

results.title: Gwamnan Kano ya ce sun rabu da matarsa kuma zai yi wani aure
results.content: Gwamnan Jihar Kano a Najeriya, Abba Kabir Yusuf, ya tabbatar a hukumance cewa sun rabu da mai ɗakinsa, Zainab Musa Kwankwaso, wadda ƴa ce ga tsohon ubangidansa a siyasa, Sanata Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso, sannan ya bayyana aniyarsa ta sake yin wani auren.

results.title: UEFA ta ayyana Philippe Diallo shugaban hukumar FFF a matayin ɗan takararta na FIFA
results.content: Shugaban Hukumar Ƙwallon Ƙafa ta Faransa FFF, Philippe Diallo, ya zama wanda ƙungiyoyin ƙwallon ƙafa na Turai suka nunawa goyon baya domin ƙalubalantar Gianni Infantino a takarar shugabancin Hukumar FIFA, bayan samun cikakken goyon bayan manyan ƙungiyoyin ƙwallon ƙafa na Turai da ke wakilci a kwamitin zartarwa na UEFA da kuma Majalisar FIFA.

results.title: Floyd Mayweather ya yi alƙawarin bunƙasa harkokin wasanni a Najeriya
results.content: Fitaccen Ɗan wasan damben nan na Amurka, Floyd Mayweather Junior, ya bayyana sha'awarsa ta tallafa wa bunƙasa wasanni tun daga tushe a Najeriya, tare da kawo gasa ta wasanni ta ƙasa da ƙasa cikin ƙasar, bayan ganawa da Gwamnan Jihar Legas, Babajide Sanwo-Olu.

results.title: Dr Ahmed Bedu, kan alƙawarin Tinubu na kakkabe Boko Haram cikin shekaru 5
results.content: Shugaban Najeriya Bola Ahmed Tinubu ya gabatar da shirin murƙushe ƙungiyar boko haram na shekaru biyar, muddin ƴan Najeriya suka sake zaɓen sa a shekara mai zuwa. Ministan ma'adinai kuma kakakin yaƙin neman zaɓen sa Dele Alake ya ce shugaban ya bada umarnin ɗaukar sojoji 28,000 da kuma ƴansanda 50,000. Alake ya ce sun yi nasarar hallaka sama da mayaƙa 15,000, yayin da wasu dubu 130,000 tare da iyalan su suka aje makaman su tare da miƙa kan su.

results.title: Yadda ƙungiyoyi masu zaman kansu ke baiwa ilimi tallafi a arewacin Najeriya
results.content: Shirin wannan mako ya duba yadda ake cigaba da ƙoƙartawa ne wajen samar da tallafin karatu ta hannun ƙungiyoyi da kuma Gidauniyar da ake kafawa a wurare daban daban a yankin Arewacin Najeriya.
